static_traits.name: He Jialin
static_traits.social_status: Having a few close friends, but not yet actively discussing one's insecurity with them; relationship with girlfriend strained by insecurity
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar problem history; never received psychotherapy/psychiatric treatment
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to specifically describe triggering situations and inner thoughts, willing to try counseling suggestions; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have been worrying my girlfriend will break up with me because I am lazy, the Fear of being labeled 'lazy' and losing her pains me greatly.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize my persistent Fear of losing my girlfriend is affecting my mental health and the relationship, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: About six months ago lost the previous job, then worked at a bookstore; Unemployment and the feeling of 'low productivity / not working hard enough' triggered persistent worry about 'being seen as lazy and broken up with', after which small mistakes at Work or resting would worsen Anxiety, further affecting sleep, diet and Work performance.

core_beliefs: Important people will eventually leave me

special_situations.event: Girlfriend coming home from work looking tired, Silence or somewhat distant
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If she is quiet or seems distant, she must be dissatisfied with me, thinking I am lazy, the relationship is being re-evaluated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently seeks verification from the partner, over-explains and apologizes, compulsively attends to the partner's emotions and hints
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She may be about to break up with me, all because I am too lazy

special_situations.event: Small mistakes occur at work or a brief rest is needed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am Making a mistake at work or resting, it proves I am lazy and a failure, sooner or later my partner will look down on me and leave
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reproach, repeatedly Reflecting on mistakes and Anxiously worrying, hoping to 'correct' to prove one is not lazy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I failed again; she will look down on me for it

special_situations.event: The Unemployment experience six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One Unemployment means I do not work hard enough, am not good enough overall; not-good-enough people lose love and relationships
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Finding new Work quickly to prove one is not lazy (but inner Self-deprecation persists)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not useful enough, I am a failure, she will leave me

special_situations.event: After communicating worries with girlfriend, she said 'it is nothing, you are overreacting', then a quarrel broke out
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If she denies the problem, my worries will push her away, meaning I always do wrong things in the relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further self-blame and apologizing, trying to ease unease through more Interpretation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I pushed her away, It is all my fault

core_conflict.wish: Longs for a partner's stable love and recognition, to be seen and accepted
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being abandoned / losing love; fearing being negated and rejected after being labeled 'lazy, failure'
defense_goal: Controlling uncertainty and avoiding abandonment through Self-monitoring and early warning
Maintaining relationship security through constant verification, apologizing and Interpretation

object_relations.self_representation: A judged failure/lazy person, someone who could be abandoned at any time
object_relations.object_representation: A potential rejecter/judge (a partner who negates oneself when distant)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the partner seems tired, silent, or distant
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other is re-evaluating the relationship and will leave oneself (Projecting one's own unease as the other's negation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First fully Empathize with their unease, gentle tone; use open-ended questions and specific Questioning, distinguishing facts from assumptions; inviting recall of counter-evidence and present-moment experience, avoiding absolute language.

manifestations: Strongly worrying about being 'alone' after a breakup, immediately associating a partner's Low mood with abandonment
Declined self-evaluation after Unemployment, thinking 'I am not productive enough / I am lazy'
Small mistakes seen as total failure
outcomes: Self-deprecation and a sense of shame
Deepening doubts about life and self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interpreting the partner's tiredness and Silence as 'she is dissatisfied with me, wants to break up'
Attributing relationship uncertainty to one's own 'laziness' rather than the partner's Work stress

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-blame and tension after small work mistakes or rest
Frequently apologizes and over-explains to keep relationships safe

exception_events.target_problem: When the partner seems distant or does not talk much, the client usually falls into catastrophic worry and quarrels with the partner, making the relationship tenser.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last week the partner seemed distant for several days in a row, the client was very worried, but that evening the partner took the initiative to apologize and Clarified it was only due to Work stress, not dissatisfaction with the relationship; the incident ended calmly, the relationship undamaged.
exception_events.reason: Different situation and support: partner's proactive Clarification and apology, client obtaining factual information; different understanding: able to Reflect afterwards 'I overreacted at the time', beginning to identify non-factual speculation.

positive_force: Partner generally supportive and able to clarify facts
The client is willing to seek help and try reality testing
Able to identify catastrophizing and overreaction afterwards
Having a small friend network (though not yet used)
negative_force: Marked catastrophic, future-predicting and personalizing thinking patterns
High external validation needs; frequent verification leads to arguments
Overreacting to small mistakes, forming widespread Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and repeated worry about the partner possibly breaking up
antecedent: Partner seeming tired, silent, or distant
Small mistakes at work or needing a short break
Recalling the Unemployment experience and self-labeling
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and future prediction, personalizing cognitive biases overlaid with self-labels ('I am lazy / a failure'), triggering high sensitivity to abandonment
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain security through high vigilance and verification, controlling uncertainty and avoiding abandonment
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension and quarrels; Guilt and self-blame worsening; irregular sleep and diet; Work performance affected

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeks reassurance from the partner and over-explains/apologizes (excessive communication)
antecedent: Partner denying the problem or saying 'it is nothing', client still feeling uneasy
Partner's Silence or Low mood after work
target_behavior.core_reason: High need for external validation and Fear of negative evaluation, trying to ease uncertainty through others' reassurance
target_behavior.function: Seeking others' recognition and comfort to lower Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Communication escalating into quarrels, Relationship tension; client's guilt and Self-denial intensifying
